entities.name: Yarus
entities.description: A centaur druid of the Zhur-Taa Clan and a leader among the Gruul Clans, who tries to summon the ancient Gruul gods.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The clans Yarus is a leader among.

entities.name: Ilharg
entities.description: Gruul god whose awakening Yarus witnessed.

entities.name: Anzrag
entities.description: A Utmungr god Yarus summoned who rampaged.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: Investigative agency dispatched to deal with Anzrag.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Agency employee who contained Anzrag in an evidence capsule.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Hosted a party at her manor.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: Summoned guild figures to a meeting at Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: Central dryad of Trostani, who attacked the guild leaders.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: Selesnya leader accused of exploiting Anzrag.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Defeated Oba with Etrata, freeing Yarus.

events.summary: Yarus summoned Anzrag, who rampaged until the Agency's Kellan contained him.
events.quote: their new employee Kellan contained him in an evidence capsule

events.summary: Yarus tried to fight his way into a party at Teysa Karlov's manor but was escorted out.
events.quote: Yarus tried to fight his way into a party at Teysa Karlov 's manor

events.summary: At Vitu-Ghazi Oba attacked the guild leaders and Yarus fought back, fatally impaling Tolsimir Wolfblood by mistake.
events.quote: he fatally impaled Tolsimir Wolfblood instead

events.summary: Yarus was captured by Oba but freed after Kaya and Etrata defeated her.
events.quote: He was captured by the dryad, but was freed after Kaya and Etrata defeated her.

relations.quote: he fatally impaled Tolsimir Wolfblood instead
